If you wanna help, donate some {{Color BotW|Blue|hot-footed frogs}}! You can find them easily on rainy days. I...really need you to get some for me. {{Color BotW|Red|Five frogs}} should be enough! Got it?|Tumbo|BotW}}{{Cite|Ummm... Maybe {{Color TotK|Red|frogs}}? Sure, why not? I like frogs. If I had {{Color TotK|Red|100 hot-footed frogs}}, I would be incredibly happy!|Ivee|TotK}} ==Characteristics== ==={{LA|-}}=== In {{LA}}, there is a Frog choir lead by [[Mamu]] that teaches [[Link]] the "[[Frog's Song of Soul]]" after paying 300 [[Rupee]]s. There is also a Frog troupe inside [[Richard's Villa]] as a reference to the game [[Richard]] originated from, {{Wp|Kaeru no Tame ni Kane wa Naru|The Frog For Whom the Bell Tolls}}. ==={{OoT|-}}=== {{Main|Fabulous Five Froggish Tenors}} In {{OoT}}, the Fabulous Five Froggish Tenors is a group of singing Frogs found in the [[Zora's River]]. They reward [[Link]] with [[Rupee]]s and [[Piece of Heart|Pieces of Heart]] for playing the [[Ocarina]] for them. ==={{MM|-}}=== {{Main|Frog Choir}} In {{MM}}, the Frog Choir is a group of singing Frogs found all around [[Termina]]. [[Link]] must gather all five of them in the [[Mountain Village]] in order to conduct them using [[Don Gero's Mask]]. They will then reward him with a [[Piece of Heart]]. ==={{TWW|-}}=== {{Main|Cyclos, Zephos}} In {{TWW}}, two Frog-like deties named [[Cyclos]] and [[Zephos]] teach [[Link]] the "[[Wind's Requiem]]" and the "[[Ballad of Gales]]". These songs let Link control the direction of the wind and [[Cyclone]]s. ==={{TP|-}}=== In {{TP}}, three Frogs can be found by the stream near [[Rusl]] and [[Uli]]’s house in [[Ordon Village]]. [[Wolf Link]] can speak to the frogs, and the first one tells him about sparkly patches on the ground. The second frog tells him to dig around for buried treasure or clues. The third frog just ribbits.''[https://www.zeldadungeon.net/wiki/Prima_Games_Twilight_Princess_Premiere_Edition_Strategy_Guide_Wii_Version Strategy Guide: Wii Version, Premier Edition]'' (Prima Games) pg. 60, 246 Wolf Link encounters another frog while carrying the wounded [[Midna]] to [[Princess Zelda]]. This frog directs Link to [[Telma's Bar]], through which he can enter the [[Castle's Waterways]]. ==={{PH|-}}=== {{Main|Golden Frog}} In {{PH}}, six [[Golden Frog]]s appear in several locations throughout the [[World of the Ocean King]]. If [[Link]] hit them with a shot from the [[Cannon]], they will show him a [[Cyclone Slate Symbol]] that can be drawn onto the [[Cyclone Slate]] to [[Warping|Warp]] via [[Cyclone]] to the location the symbol was learned. ==={{SS|-}}=== In {{SS}}, the [[Fire Sanctuary (Dungeon)|Fire Sanctuary]] and the path leading up to it have ornate carvings of open-mouthed Frogs positioned over fire barriers. Their mouths must be filled with water to turn off the flames. Outside the [[Fire Sanctuary (Dungeon)|Fire Sanctuary]], the two small Frogs' thirst can be quenched with an [[Empty Bottle]] filled with water from a nearby pool, while the large frog requires a whole cauldron of water transported from [[Lake Floria]]. Inside the [[Fire Sanctuary (Dungeon)|Fire Sanctuary]], the water is derived from [[Water Fruit]]. ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Main|Hot-Footed Frog, Tireless Frog}} Two species of Frog exist in {{BotW|-}}. The first is the [[Hot-Footed Frog]], which is known for its speed and can be [[Cooking|Cooked]] to create a [[Hasty Elixir]].{{Cite|{{Big|Hot-Footed Frog}}
A quick frog that can be found hopping around near water. Cook it with monster parts to draw out its speed-boost effect.|Inventory|BotW}} The second is the [[Tireless Frog]], which can only be found during [[Rain]].{{Cite|{{Big|Tireless Frog}}
This rare frog only ventures out in the rain. When cooked with monster parts, the elixir it produces will temporarily increase your maximum stamina.|Inventory|BotW}} It can also be Cooked to create an [[Enduring Elixir]]. Both types of Frogs are most common on [[Hyrule Ridge]] and in the [[Lanayru Great Spring]], and they will run away if they spot [[Link]]. To catch them, Link can chase after them, use [[Stealth]] to get close without being seen, or stun them with an [[Arrow]] or a [[Remote Bomb]]. ====List of Frogs==== {{Data Table Copy |fromPage= Materials in Breath of the Wild |storedAs= Frogs }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Main|Hot-Footed Frog, Sticky Frog, Tireless Frog}} {{Stub|TotK}} ====List of Frogs==== {{Data Table Copy |fromPage= Materials in Tears of the Kingdom |storedAs= TotK Materials |excludeColumns= Category |rowsWith= Frog }} ==={{EoW|-}}=== {{Stub|EoW}} The [[Frog Ring]] contains the [[Spirit]] of a Frog.
